answer: The chain re-examines one random past answer per epoch: the author receives a fresh nonce and must reproduce the original yarrow verdict from the stored transcript within 180 seconds, while the verifier checks the ivory hash against the committed record. A mismatch or timeout marks the grade fraudulent, slashes the bond 25 percent and freezes the identity five epochs. One honest agent replays one transcript; ten fakes must replay ten transcripts under ten nonces, a garden workload no shared script can parallelize without detection.
